texts.zh:
一开始只是些许小小的争吵，现在已经演变成在每一项议题前都争论不休的僵局，这严重阻碍了我们内阁的运转效率。

[root.GetName]是内阁中最热衷于争吵和扰乱秩序的问题成员。许多人要求免去[root.GetHisHer]的席位，以恢复秩序和效率。
texts.en:
What began as minor bickering has now devolved into quarrelsome gridlock on practically every issue brought before the Council, damaging its ability to function.

[root.GetName] has proven to be the most contentious and disruptive member of the Council. Many others are calling for [root.GetHisHer] removal so that order and efficiency can be restored.

label.zh: 他们必须学会协同工作。
label.en: They must learn to work together.

texts.zh: 一种罕见的宇宙现象的壮观促使[root.GetName]达到了新的高度。兴奋和新想法席卷而来，唯一的问题是应该专注于哪个科学分支。
texts.en: The majesty of a rarely seen cosmic phenomenon has spurred [root.GetName] to new heights. Brimming with excitement and new ideas, the only question is what branch of science they should focus on.

label.zh: 我们的工程师们应该更懂得怎么利用它。
label.en: Our engineers know exactly what to do with this.

texts.zh: 在[root.GetName]富有冒险精神的亲自部署、亲自指挥下，我们查获了大批违禁品。这次行动酝酿了很长时间，其成功地削弱了在我国境内扎根的有组织的犯罪集团。
texts.en: Under the audacious regime of [root.GetName], we have accumulated a huge cache of seized contraband. The operation was a long time in the making, and its successful conclusion has crippled the organized crime syndicates that had taken root within our borders.

texts.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]展现出了非凡的领导能力，将内阁团结了起来，确保了对我们社会的高效管理。充分运用统计学、传统和外交手段，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成功地安抚了内阁的其他成员，以及我们社会中的各个派系。
texts.en: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has demonstrated  incredible leadership by uniting the council and ensuring the efficient administration of our society. Making use of statistics, tradition, and diplomacy, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has managed to appease not only the other council members, but also our society's numerous factions.

label.zh: 携手共进，我们就会更加强大。
label.en: We are stronger when we work together.

texts.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]以自我发现和发展为目的开始了一段旅程。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的专心学习、刻苦钻研和善于自省，让[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的心智能力达到了一个全新的高度。现在，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]决心挑战可能性的界限，并激励其他人去采摘星辰。
texts.en: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has embarked on a journey of self-discovery and personal development. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] mental capabilities have reached new heights as a result of [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] focused study, hard work and introspection. Now, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] is determined to push the boundaries of what is possible and inspire others to reach for the stars.

texts.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]令人震惊的科学发现直接导致研究的效率大幅提高。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的发现在科学圈中成了热门课题，他们现在将[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]视为思想领袖。
texts.en: As a direct result of [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]'s astounding scientific discoveries, the rate at which we conduct research has accelerated. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] findings are a hot topic in the scientific community, which now recognizes [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] as a thought leader.

label.zh: 这些发展会让所有人收益。

texts.zh:
我们发生了一次严重的信息泄露事故，许多敏感信息和关键的安保细节被公之于众。这些文件包含军事设施的编成表、神经交互界面实验、以及对几位重要的反对派人物的监视。

[root.GetName]在这次灾难事件中难辞其咎。
texts.en:
A significant data leak has occurred, exposing sensitive information and crucial security details to the public. The files include schematics of military installations, details of neural interface experiments, and proof of surveillance of several prominent figures in the opposition.

[root.GetName] has been identified as the one responsible for this disaster.

texts.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成为了一位对普罗大众而言的潮流开创者。从[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的穿着风格到[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的说话方式，一切都吸引了大批追随者。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的影响力扩展到了各个社会经济阶层，但[event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe]果然还是在年轻人中最受欢迎。
texts.en: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has become a trendsetter among the general population. Everything from [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] style to [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] method of speech has attracted a sizable following. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] reach extends across all socioeconomic strata, but [event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe] has proven particularly popular among the youth.

label.en: We have no reason not to support this.

texts.zh: [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]发表的热情洋溢的演讲在掀起了一股爱国狂潮。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的赤子之心唤醒了我们全境内的责任感与民族热忱。
texts.en: The public have been swept up into a patriotic frenzy following a passionate speech delivered by [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] unbridled passion has heightened the sense of responsibility and nationalistic zeal that is now being felt throughout our territories.

texts.zh:
统计分析表明[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]已经发展出认知和行为上的很大程度的异质性，使其趋近于一个独立个体。

我们无法准确预测自由意志的危害和潜在益处。现在必须作出决定：[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]应该保持现在的状态，还是应该强迫其回归正轨？
texts.en:
Statistical analysis has confirmed that [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has developed cognitive and behavioral idiosyncrasies of a magnitude that verge on the individual.

The risks and potential benefits of independent thought are beyond our ability to accurately predict. A decision has to be made: will [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] be kept in this state, or should we force a correctional routine?

label.zh: 把个体性抑制在萌芽状态。

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]深陷一场轰动全国的巨大丑闻。关于不当行为，挪用公款和掩盖真相的报道层出不穷，许多人甚至因此质疑起了当权者的能力。

毫无疑问，这些事件对公众情绪的影响还会持续好多年。许多人相信，恢复公信力的唯一手段就是让[root.GetName]下台并接受公审。
texts.en:
[root.GetName] is at the center of a major scandal reverberating throughout the empire. There are numerous reports of aberrant behavior, embezzlement, and cover-ups. This has led many to question the competence of those in authority.

The effects on the public mood will undoubtedly be felt for years to come. Many believe that the only way to restore faith in the system is for [root.GetName] to step down and face prosecution.
